scope: Local relativistic optics and first-jet reconstruction; deterministic analysis only.

conventions.observer: O=c o, o.o=-1, future directed, fixed at the observation event
conventions.null_direction: K=-o+n, n.o=0, n.n=1, past affine tangent, o.K=1
conventions.rates: Q, B, H, theta, sigma, W have units s^-1
conventions.vorticity: W_ab=h_a^c h_b^d ∇_[c U_d]; equals minus c times the book's velocity-first vorticity
conventions.error_norms: Euclidean vector/Frobenius/operator norms in one fixed observer orthonormal tetrad

shared_assumptions: Smooth time-oriented Lorentzian metric and a common smooth source velocity field on a neighbourhood of the observation event.
Metric geometric optics on a vertex null bundle before conjugate points.
Ideal absolute directional redshift intercept and independently calibrated area-distance slope at zero distance.
Full sky and known common observer tetrad.
No Einstein equation, material equation of state, geodesicity, irrotationality or homogeneity assumed unless a claim explicitly adds one.

claims.title: Optical zeroth and first distance orders
claims.statement: Z(n)=u.K and H(n)=c dz/dd_A|0=B(K,K), with d_A=ell+O(ell^3).
claims.proof: Endpoint frequency ratio, affine parallel transport, and vertex Jacobi initial conditions.
claims.novelty_category: Established GR identities rederived with explicit conventions.
limitations: Not redshift drift.
No finite-distance remainder constant is inferred from smoothness alone.
Luminosity-distance substitution additionally requires distance duality.

claims.title: Complete accelerated joint image and unique inverse
claims.statement: Exactly the future-unit monopole/dipole intercepts times arbitrary real degree<=2 slopes occur. With S00=h0, S0i=-h1_i/2, Sij=h2ij STF, u=(zeta0,zeta), B=S+S(u,u)g.
claims.proof: Intercept mass shell; complete null-cone kernel span(g); B(u,u)=0; constructive sufficiency.
claims.novelty_category: Elementary algebraic synthesis/direct deduction; priority not established.
limitations: First-jet kinematic image only.
No positivity condition on H.
Source material constraints are not included.

claims.title: Complete derivative fibre and recovered acceleration/deformation
claims.statement: Writing b=B.u, all eligible jets are Q=B+b⊗u−u⊗b+W with W antisymmetric and W.u=0. A=2c b; theta and sigma are spatial trace and tracefree projections of B.
claims.proof: Direct normalization and symmetric-part contractions; subtraction establishes exhaustiveness.
claims.novelty_category: Known kinematic decomposition plus explicit inverse fibre; no priority claim.
limitations: Three free spatial antisymmetric components remain.
No vorticity recovery from the scalar first-order sky.
Derivative-first sign differs from the supplied book.

claims.title: Local realization of all admissible pairs and fibre elements
claims.statement: Every pair and W allowed by OPT02–OPT03 is realized by a smooth future unit congruence locally in any fixed smooth Lorentzian metric.
claims.proof: Normal-coordinate linear seed with derivative Q/c, normalized by sqrt(-g(v,v)); normalization correction has zero first derivative.
claims.novelty_category: Standard local-jet construction applied to this image theorem; no priority claim.
limitations: Neighbourhood may have to shrink.
Does not realize specified Einstein/matter stress energy, symmetry or global extension.
Higher jets and finite-distance laws are not fixed.

claims.title: Deterministic finite-error inverse bound without an eigengap
claims.statement: For two admissible pairs with rapidities <=R, let M=sqrt(cosh(2R)), epsilon_Z be the Euclidean intercept coefficient difference, epsilon_H^2=delta h0^2+|delta h1|^2/2+||delta h2||F^2, and L=min(||S||op,||S_tilde||op). Then |delta u|E=epsilon_Z and ||delta B||F<=(1+2M^2)epsilon_H+4ML epsilon_Z.
claims.proof: Exact finite difference of S(u,u), Cauchy–Schwarz in the fixed observer tetrad, and ||g||F=2.
claims.novelty_category: Explicit derived deterministic estimate; sharpness and priority not established.
limitations: Compares admissible pairs.
Rate-amplitude dependence is necessary and explicit.
Error sizes and ideal-data validity are assumed, not calibrated.
No expansion eigengap is needed.

claims.title: Optional off-shell deterministic normalization map
claims.statement: Clip a supplied dipole to |d|<=sinh R and set u*=(sqrt(1+|d|^2),d). A dipole error eta_d implies |u*−u|E<=sqrt(1+tanh^2 R) eta_d, followed by OPT05 with a known representative norm. The monopole mismatch is bounded separately.
claims.proof: Nonexpansiveness of projection onto a convex Euclidean ball and bounded gradient of sqrt(1+|d|^2).
limitations: Optional extension, not the core image theorem.
Does not certify mass-shell or harmonic compatibility of supplied data.
No statistical calibration.
Forbidden harmonics are not erased as evidence.

claims.title: Complete geodesic slope-only image and degeneracy
claims.statement: A degree<=2 slope admits A(p)=0 iff S^a_b has a timelike eigenvector. Its timelike eigenvalue s_t and B=S−s_t g are unique. Source velocities are the future unit vectors in that eigenspace, a hyperbolic fibre H^r if r spatial expansion eigenvalues vanish.
claims.proof: Lorentz self-adjoint eigenvector orthogonality, decomposition around a timelike eigenvector, and ordinary spatial spectral theorem.
claims.novelty_category: Algebraic clarification of known boosted Hubble inversion; priority not established.
limitations: Geodesicity or A(p)=0 is required.
Repeated nonzero spatial eigenvalues do not obstruct velocity uniqueness.
Zero spatial expansion eigenvalues obstruct velocity uniqueness but not B uniqueness.
Not every real S has a timelike eigenvector.

claims.title: Failure of uniform slope-only velocity stability near degeneracy
claims.statement: The displayed epsilon-family has bounded rapidity and rates, distinct fixed source velocities, and slope coefficient differences tending to zero as one spatial expansion eigenvalue tends to zero.
claims.proof: Explicit B_epsilon,chi built from an orthonormal source spatial frame; null contractions computed exactly.
limitations: Slope-only, geodesic first-jet statement.
Intercepts differ, so it does not refute joint reconstruction.
Does not establish equality of full finite-distance laws or global cosmologies.

claims.title: Exact first-order velocity inverse with arbitrary shear
claims.statement: For fixed invertible D=(theta/3)I+sigma and small beta_O/U, beta_O/U=−(1/2)D^−1 h1+O(beta^2)=−(1/2)(h0 I+h2)^−1 h1+O(beta^2).
claims.proof: Direct inversion of the leading boosted dipole while retaining the full spatial expansion matrix.
limitations: Error constants depend on D inverse.
A weak-shear truncation is separate from a velocity truncation.
Maartens v3 Eq.37 is not used as an unrestricted-shear inverse.

primary_sources.citation: Maartens, Santiago, Clarkson, Kalbouneh & Marinoni, JCAP 09 (2024) 070
primary_sources.scope_warning: Their setup is dust/geodesic, with negligible vorticity; the arbitrary accelerated image theorem is derived here.

primary_sources.citation: Ellis, Maartens & MacCallum, Relativistic Cosmology, CUP 2012

prior_inputs.role: Review evidence and issue list, not authority

unresolved: Prior-art/priority investigation beyond the inspected primary bridge.
Operational existence and bounded extrapolation errors for the ideal zero-distance data in an actual source population.
Realization within a selected constrained Einstein/material or homogeneous model family.
Sharp constants for the deterministic B inverse bound.
Identification of any homogeneous-orbit normal and inference of matter tilt relative to it.
nonclaims: No statistical confidence statement or calibration.
No proof of a new physical observational effect.
No unrestricted matter-tilt or Bianchi classification.
No global uniqueness or full finite-distance law reconstruction.
